title: Yap, Yap, Yum!
lines: Sal has a pup. It can yap a lot.
Mom naps, but the pup yaps and yaps.
"Do not yap yet," said Sal. "Mom naps."
The pup yaps and taps at the pan.
"Yes! It is not fed yet," said Sal.
Sal gets a bit of ham in the pan.
"Yum!" The pup sits and has the ham.
It naps on the rug. Sal pats it.

questions.ask: What did the pup do when Mom was napping?
questions.listenFor: It yapped and yapped. Line two says it. If your child is not sure, point at that line and let them read it again.

questions.ask: How did Sal work out what the pup was yapping about?
questions.listenFor: The pup yapped and tapped at the pan, so Sal knew it had not been fed. Lines four and five tell it together.

questions.ask: What else might a pup yap about? Tell me why you think that.
questions.listenFor: Any answer counts. You are listening for a reason of their own, such as it wants to go out or it hears a bug.
